in_band_test_facilities.name: Lane Margining at the Receiver
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Gen5-mandatory; in-system eye-margin probe that steps the receiver sampling point in time (left/right) and optionally voltage (up/down) in L0 without interrupting traffic, reporting the error rate per lane.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Compliance Pattern at 32 GT/s
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: LTSSM Polling.Compliance transmits a defined pattern at 32 GT/s for electrical eye / jitter characterization.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Loopback test mode
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Loopback Master → Slave → Master pattern echo for receiver-eye and SerDes testing at 32 GT/s.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Equalization preset control
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Secondary PCIe Extended Capability exposes per-lane Transmitter Preset and Receiver Preset Hint for the four-phase EQ; usable for characterization.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Hot Reset / Disable Link
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Force re-train or Electrical Idle for power / characterization.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Advanced Error Reporting (AER)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: In-protocol observability of correctable / uncorrectable / fatal errors.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Link Status Register — current LTSSM state, negotiated Link Speed (up to 32 GT/s) + Link Width.
Link Status 2 Register — current de-emphasis / equalization phase status.
Lane Margining at the Receiver registers — per-lane time/voltage margin step + error-count status.
Device Status Register — Correctable / Non-Fatal / Fatal Error Detected, Unsupported Request Detected.
AER Uncorrectable Error Status / Mask / Severity + Header Log — fine-grained protocol-error observability.
VC Resource Status Register — per-VC negotiation status.
out_of_band_test_facilities: Gen5-capable protocol analyzers (interposer or mid-board tap) decoding 128b/130b block streams at 32 GT/s into TLPs / DLLPs / Ordered Sets.
Vendor PHY debug ports (PIPE-style) — implementation-defined scan + debug, not in the Base Spec.
fields.notes: PCI Express 5.0 adds Lane Margining at the Receiver as a mandatory protocol-level DFT/observability feature for in-system signal integrity at 32 GT/s, plus the equalization preset registers needed to drive the four-phase EQ. JTAG / scan-chain / BIST are NOT specified at the protocol level — those remain integrator-side at the SoC.
